title: Biefeld affidavit confirming anomalous effect

tellings.quote: Paul Biefeld. They say he never met Paul Biefeld and then this affidavit comes out later. Paul Biefeld definitely met Townsend Brown.

plain: The inventor Townsend Brown, critics say, never met a man named Paul Alfred Biefeld, whose name is tied to a strange electrical effect Brown studied in Ohio. But a sworn written statement from Biefeld that came out later is said to show they did. Paul Schatzkin, who has studied Brown's life, tells this himself, with only the affidavit as a source: "Paul Biefeld definitely met Townsend Brown." If true, it backs up Brown's account of how his work on the effect began.
